promotionCandidates.title: Align shared export guidance with ADR-0005's scoped-only decision

evidence.note: The live orientation guide says there is no root or schemas barrel but promises a separate future aggregate-export leaf.
The Gotchas section repeats the deferred-leaf promise immediately before requiring defining-file imports and forbidding compatibility re-exports.
Accepted ADR-0005 makes the opposite durable decision: scoped subpaths only, the schemas barrel stays removed, and the absent root export is gated.
The live prior record relies on the no-barrel state when declining generic schema renames but does not settle the guide's promised aggregate-export review.

promotionCandidates.problem: Contributor guidance presents a root or schemas aggregate export as intended deferred work while the accepted and enforced ADR treats either export as an architecture regression. promotionCandidates.title: Standardize dateTimeField-backed mapper result boundaries

evidence.note: dateTimeField explicitly accepts Prisma Date values as schema input and owns canonical Date-to-ISO normalization.
mapLayerSchema applies dateTimeField to both timestamps and exports the normalized output type.
The map-detail mapper family derives schema-input result contracts with z.input.
One MapLayer mapper returns raw Prisma Date values through that input contract.
A second mapper targeting the same schema instead uses its output type and manually duplicates both ISO conversions.
Campaign member, detail, and summary mappers repeat field-by-field timestamp normalization despite dateTimeField-backed contracts.
Combat-log and encounter mapper families likewise distribute ISO policy through their implementations.

evidence.measurement: 45 matches across 18 files (`rg -n 'toISOString\(\)' packages/server/src --glob '!*.test.ts' --glob '!*.test.tsx' | wc -l`; `rg -l 'toISOString\(\)' packages/server/src --glob '!*.test.ts' --glob '!*.test.tsx' | wc -l`)
evidence.note: This bounds the inventory requiring classification; it is not a claim that all 45 calls should be removed.
The prior pack's own source leaf identifies uniform mapper retyping as a separate larger question rather than resolving it.

promotionCandidates.problem: dateTimeField already owns the Prisma-Date-to-wire-string boundary, but server mapper families inconsistently return schema input or manually construct schema output. This duplicates serialization policy, makes timestamp additions coordinated schema-and-mapper edits, and obscures whether every raw mapper result reaches a real parse boundary.
promotionCandidates.proposedDirection: Inventory dateTimeField-backed mappers and their consumers, then convert cohesive domains to z.input result contracts that pass Prisma Dates to the existing schema parse. Keep pagination, logging, protocol timestamps, and deliberately string-only homebrew and magic-item schemas excluded.
